items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: Ever used Kit Howard or Paul Barnes?

ctx.x: Saxophone. And Mr. Fatty, Louie Contrell, he played a couple times with me. That's our president, local president. You know.
Ever used Kit Howard or Paul Barnes?
Yeah, the kid played a couple times with me too. He played a couple of jobs I had, Jackson Barracks and a couple other spots I, you know, booked them on.
